jobs.name: Milestone Collector
jobs.description: Claimed every milestone in a round, at least once.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE minimalist tournament achievement emblem for the center of an existing hexagonal game badge.
Style: match a clean raised enamel pictogram collection. Broad solid geometric shapes, smooth ivory faces with warm gold rims, narrow polished bevels, thin dark perimeter, gentle upper-left highlights. Front-on orthographic view. Consistent restrained depth. Warm gold and ivory only. No texture, no photographic detail. Instantly recognizable at 48 pixels tall.
Composition: one compact, balanced centered emblem occupying around 75 percent of a square canvas, generous transparent margins; every part fully visible.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the objects AND in all gaps and openings. No black backdrop, no opaque or translucent backdrop, no glow, no haze, no stray pixels.
Do not include a badge frame, hexagon, backing disc, laurels, wings, sparkles, scene, floor shadow, letters, words, labels, or additional objects. Only include a numeral when explicitly requested below. Single asset, not a presentation sheet.
Subject: exactly THREE clearly separate upright milestone flags, arranged as a compact group with the middle flag slightly taller and the two flanking flags equal height. Each is one broad simple ivory pennant attached to one thick gold vertical pole. All three pennants point right and have one simple swallowtail notch at their right edge. Identical flag designs, equal importance, clean empty gaps between them. The poles are short and chunky so the flag faces remain large and readable. Three flags total; no shared base, no terrain, no number, no checkmarks, no ribbon, no extra ornament.
jobs.edit_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied three ivory-and-gold flags achievement emblem. Remove ALL background, black backdrop, gold glow, haze and floor shadows around the objects AND from ALL spaces between them. Return ONLY the three exact objects as crisp clean cutouts on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Preserve their existing shapes, colors, bevels, highlights, relative positions, spacing and proportions. Nothing else may be changed or added. No drop shadow, no glow, no halo. Fit the complete group, centered without cropping any object, on a square transparent canvas with generous empty margins.

jobs.name: The Full Package
jobs.symbol: A complete package with a checkmark.
jobs.description: Won a round while claiming every milestone and every award.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE minimal achievement emblem to sit inside an existing game badge.
Reference image: MATERIAL AND STYLE only, unless specified otherwise. Match smooth ivory enamel faces, warm polished gold edging, shallow raised bevels, very thin dark edges, and upper-left highlights. Broad solid pictogram shapes, immediately recognizable at small sizes.
Composition: a single compact centered emblem, front-on, square canvas with generous empty margins. Genuinely transparent alpha outside the emblem and in every opening.
Avoid: outer badge or frame, backing plate, presentation sheet, scenery, fine texture, ornament, sparkles, glow, haze, cast shadow, tiny details, or extra lettering.
Subject: ONE closed GIFT PACKAGE, straight-on, with a broad square IVORY box, a simple overhanging lid edged in gold, and a tidy GOLD bow on top made of exactly two broad rounded loops. One broad GOLD CHECKMARK is centered on the front face of the ivory box and dominates that face, clearly signaling complete. Keep the lid, box and bow simple; no wrapping patterns, ribbon crossing the checkmark, small ornaments or text. Wide open gap inside each bow loop. The box, bow and single checkmark form one compact unmistakable parcel icon.

jobs.name: Making Your Mark
jobs.symbol: A milestone flag paired with a star-centred award medal.
jobs.description: Recorded the highest combined milestone and award total across a tournament’s qualifying rounds, including ties.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE minimalist achievement emblem for the center of an existing hexagonal game badge.
Style: front-on polished enamel pictogram, broad smooth warm-IVORY faces, narrow WARM GOLD beveled edges and details, subtle upper-left highlights, very thin dark edge accents, restrained shallow relief. Match a premium ivory-and-gold game achievement family. Clear chunky silhouettes recognizable at small sizes; no fine texture.
Composition: one compact, centered emblem on a square canvas, all parts visible, generous transparent margin on all sides.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the objects and in every gap. No black backdrop, white backdrop, checkerboard, halo, glow, haze, floor or cast shadow.
Avoid: outer badge frame, surrounding hexagon, decorative backing plate, laurel, decorative flourishes, scenery, presentation sheet, tiny detail. Produce just this one emblem.
Subject: ONE upright milestone FLAG combined with ONE award MEDAL in a compact unified symbol. At left, a thick polished-gold vertical flagpole with a small round finial; near the top, a broad ivory enamel swallowtail pennant with a narrow gold border, pointing right. In the lower right, partially in front of the flagpole, one large round ivory enamel medal with a gold rim, a single bold gold five-point STAR centered on the medal, and two short broad gold ribbon tails below it. The flag and medal are both plainly recognizable, balanced in size, with no extra objects. Flat front view with simple smooth enamel relief. A cohesive slightly taller-than-wide emblem. No text, numbers, letters, extra flags, extra medals, wreath, crown, tiny engraving, ornamental patterns, or surrounding frame.

rules.the-full-package: Won a round and claimed every milestone and every award: roundAchievements().perfect.
rules.making-your-mark: After all qualifying milestone and award records are finalized, sum milestones_claimed + awards_won per player across completed played qualifying games in this tournament. Award to everyone tied for the highest positive total. Exclude Finals, byes and unplayed games; missing records are unknown, not zero. No table win or podium finish is required.

notes.makingYourMark: A milestone flag and star-centred award medal combine the two established symbols. First concept awaiting review. Artwork does not implement achievement evaluation.
